entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: An aristocratic human from Urborg, born of Urza's Bloodline Project, who was driven mad, became a vampire and then a Phyrexian evincar of Rath.

entities.name: Crovax, Ascendant Hero
entities.description: An alternate-reality version of Crovax who re-emerged after grief over Mirri's and Selenia's loss.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: An angel bound to an artifact to protect Crovax's family estate, whom Crovax loved.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A Weatherlight crewman who befriends Crovax and eventually kills him.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: A Weatherlight crewman Crovax befriended, the first casualty of the battle at Urborg.

entities.name: Morinfen
entities.description: A Phyrexian agent who laid waste to Crovax's family lands.

entities.name: Gallowbraid
entities.description: A Phyrexian agent who laid waste to Crovax's family lands.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: A friend who informs Crovax that Selenia left for Rath.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior wounded by Selenia and killed by Crovax.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: The Weatherlight's healer who comforts Crovax.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian Dark Lord whose voice commands Crovax.

entities.name: Kirril
entities.description: A Phyrexian who taught Crovax to consume lifeforce and transformed him.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The former evincar of Rath, who is defeated by Crovax in a duel.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: A Phyrexian emissary who refuses to name Crovax evincar and is killed by Eladamri.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A wizard rival to Crovax who aids him in the duel and is compleated into his court mage.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: An army commander and rival for evincar status.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: Crovax's second-in-command, executed for her failure at Koilos.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin resurrected so Crovax can kill him repeatedly.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship Crovax serves aboard.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane where Crovax becomes evincar.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Crovax's home island.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane to which Crovax is taken for compleation.

entities.name: Jolav
entities.description: Crovax's brother.

events.summary: Crovax leaves Urborg to join the Weatherlight crew, taking the artifact binding Selenia.
events.quote: He took with him the artifact controlling Selenia so that he could be with her.

events.summary: The Phyrexian agents Morinfen and Gallowbraid slaughter Crovax's family; Rofellos dies and Selenia defeats the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Rofellos became the first casualty of the battle.

events.summary: Crovax shatters the artifact binding Selenia, who flies away, and he is cursed to destroy all that he loves.
events.quote: He was now destined to destroy all that he loved.

events.summary: On Rath, Crovax sees Selenia leading an attack against the Weatherlight and breaks down.
events.quote: Embittered by his love's betrayal, Crovax became obsessed with getting revenge.

events.summary: Crovax tears apart a shapeshifter in Selenia's guise inside the Stronghold.
events.quote: In a fit of rage, he pursued it and tore it apart, much to the shock of his allies.

events.summary: Crovax strikes down Selenia, who shatters into shards that warp him into a vampire.
events.quote: Crovax's curse had been fulfilled: he had killed the love of his life and had been damned because of it.

events.summary: Crovax kills Mirri after she follows him on deck and they fall into Volrath's garden.
events.quote: where Crovax then proceeded to kill the cat warrior.

events.summary: Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril compleats him into a Phyrexian and he is groomed as evincar of Rath.
events.quote: he was to become the new evincar of Rath, needing only to prove himself to his masters before he could take the throne.

events.summary: Crovax defeats Greven, fails against the Skyshroud rebels, and impales 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes.
events.quote: Crovax impaled the hostages on flowstone spikes.

events.summary: Crovax forces Belbe by coup to name him evincar, then defeats Volrath in a duel thanks to Ertai.
events.quote: With his victory over Volrath, Crovax's Coronation was a fact and his reign as evincar began.

events.summary: Crovax executes Volrath, buries Belbe, and has Ertai compleated.
events.quote: He also had Ertai compleated into a Phyrexian and made him his court mage.

events.summary: After the Rathi Overlay, Crovax oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executes Tsabo Tavoc, and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
events.quote: This convinced Gerrard to surrender himself to the Dark Lord.

events.summary: Crovax leads the counterattack against Multani's Yavimaya, raising the undead.
events.quote: He demonstrated his necromantic abilities by raising an army of the undead

events.summary: Gerrard, returned with Yawgmoth's boons, slices Crovax in half; Selenia recovers his normal soul.
events.quote: eventually being sliced in half by Gerrard.

relations.quote: Over time, Crovax became besotted with the angel, who was unable to return his affections.

relations.note: struck her down in the dungeons
